name: it2s
description: Let one Codex/Claude session watch, drive, and supervise every other iTerm2 tab.

interface.longDescription: CLI + skill that lets one agent session list, read, drive, and wait on every other iTerm2 tab (Claude Code, Codex, shells), with a hook-fed session registry and alerts. Run install.sh once for the CLI and Codex hooks.
defaultPrompt: What are my other iTerm2 sessions doing?
Run one ops cycle over my agent sessions.
